control.meaning: Pointer and count of 16 byte records. Meaning not traced.
Pointer and count of 8 byte pairs. Each pair is a pointer to u16 node indices of the child unit and a count. An emitter sends its payload to one group per receiver kind.
Pointer and count. Meaning not traced.
Zero or an offset up to the payload length.
Index into the declaration table. Rewritten to the module index.

link.meaning: Pointer and count of u32 link codes.
Pointer and count of u32 link codes.
Index of the control entry this node uses. A permutation in every installed effect.

unit.meaning: Pointer and count of u16 indices into the link array.
Pointer and count of u16 instance indices.
Pointer and count of 8 byte records: s32 start tick, u16 index into the child instance list, u16 zero.
Pointer and count of 12 byte graph records. The first u16 indexes the standard graph table.
Same for the random graph table.
The unit ends when its time reaches this value. The root unit holds 0x7fffffff.
With the loop flag set, the time returns to this tick after the loop end.
The loop end is the start plus this length. The time wraps by this length.

Number of loops allowed. Every installed unit holds 0xff, which stores no count: the unit loops only while the call 0x00bb35d0(1) on the object at UnitNode +0x00 returns false. That call tests bit 0 of the dword at +0x28 of that object and the meaning of the bit is UNKNOWN. The length pass tests the byte at 0x00bd2d0d.

materialElement.meaning: A name, reversed tag and flags dword whose bit 1 marks it unused, read by 0x00d85f80 with the flags at +0x14.
Passed to the model with the reference.
Pointer to an array of record pointers and a count.
Mapped by 0x00d815d0 and stored at node +0x46.
Values 1 and 2 are kept and anything else becomes 0, stored at node +0x45.
Bit 0 sets node flag bit 2 and bit 1 sets node flag bit 0.

slot.meaning: Selects the slot size in the table at 0x01305b50 together with the graph module width nibble.
Index into the unit graph A list.
Index into the bindings of that graph record.
0xff for none, otherwise an index into the unit graph B list.

graphRecord.meaning: Index into the standard table for the unit list at +0x18 and into the random table for +0x20. The entry must have a nonzero u16 at descriptor +6.
0 or 1, anything else logs graph overflow id error.

graphBinding.meaning: Offset of a u32 that holds the offset of the first segment.
Offset of one u32 start tick per segment, non decreasing and starting at 0 in all but 10 installed bindings.

graphSegment.meaning: 0, 1 or 2 in the installed polynomial graphs.
1 to 4, equal to the width in the module name.
components * (degree + 1) f32 values, component major, constant term first. Segments follow each other with no padding in the install.

instance.check: instance flag and unit index read

instance.meaning: Read by SetCullingType_ 0x00bd38d0 as an index into the draw layer table.

linkCodes.meaning: unit local: bits 16 to 27 pick a unit definition (0x34 bytes in the runtime table), the low 16 bits pick a control node of that unit; resolves to the target work base plus 0x10

family: bits 16 to 27 pick a declaration; the unit nodes and then the parent unit nodes are searched for that module or one derived from it, then the descriptor provider slot +0xbc, then the default target +0xd8
fixed: matched by the node module index in the low 16 bits first, then falls back to the family search with a warning

The routine 0x00c13c20 registers 21 named material constants from the table at 0x013086a0, each with a byte size and a four float default, among them controlColor, modulateColor, fogParam, fogColor, textureMatrix0 to 3, uvofs0 to 3 and vfxSoftParticleParam. Every installed vmdl root holds a shader set array at +0x18 with a count at +0x1c and 20 byte entries of vertex pointer, vertex size, pixel pointer, pixel size and a zero word, and a texture reference array at +0x20. Each shader record is a 16 byte key, a big endian length, 12 pad bytes and a Direct3D 9 token stream of that length that starts with the version token 0xfffe0300 for vertex shaders and 0xffff0300 for pixel shaders. The roles come from the install and from the creator that passes record +0x20 and size minus 0x20 to the shader factory.

In every installed veff the instances form a tree. Instance 0 names unit 0, no list references it, and every other instance appears in exactly one unit child list. The control and link arrays have equal counts and the link control index is a permutation. Unit schedules are sorted by start tick.

A control array entry carries the declaration index and a parameter block. A link array entry names one control entry and carries the link code lists. A unit lists the link entries that form its control nodes. The install shows these relations hold in every effect, the traced code shows how the lists are read.

The effect clock counts ticks. The division of a tick delta by 300000.0 to seconds in the resource kind 7 calc, and the division of the flipbook word by 5000.0 to a frame, give 60 frames per second when one tick is 1/300000 s. The unit is not tied to a frame source in this page.

A polynomial binding is evaluated at x = (unit time - segment start) / 5000, where the unit time is the tick word at UnitNode +0x8c and the segment is the first one whose next start the unit time has not reached. The routine at 0x00be4550 walks the segments, calls the module slot +0x24 at each boundary and the evaluator slot +0x20 with x. The slot +0x24 of a polynomial module stores the constant term of the entered segment plus the carried value.

The parameter blocks of the Generate and ManyGenerate emitters are decoded on the generate emitters page. The parameter blocks of the other controls, including how the position, angle and scale controls obtain their vectors and which graph output feeds the matrix controls, are not read.
The model chunk with magic mxfv or vfxm that the vmdl root points to at +0x2c holds the vertex, index, sprite and material data. Its layout is not read.
The material parameter record switch in 0x00d86010 handles type codes 1 to 0x16. Only the color slot write and the texture matrix case were followed.
The caller that supplies the tick delta to the frame driver and the value of the time scale float at effect +0xd4 were not traced.

Every emitter draw comes from one MT19937 object whose pointer is stored at 0x0137b780. The DefaultContext constructor 0x00bc3aa0 calls clock() and hands the result to the generator constructor 0x00bc3980. A unit draw multiplies the output word by 1/4294967295 and a signed draw multiplies the word as a signed integer by 2^-31.

A Genesis graph binding holds the cumulative event count as a polynomial of degree 0, 1 or 2 in the frame time of its segment. Each graph update emits the truncated peak count of the step minus the count already emitted, and entering a degree 0 segment emits the truncated constant term minus the count emitted. The count already emitted lives at value +0x0c.

An event is queued with its age in ticks and the control node that holds the Genesis slot receives it from the event pass 0x00bdb6e0 through descriptor slot +0x9c, once per event. The traced handlers do not read the age.

The GenerateMaster handler spawns when a unit draw is not above the base chance plus the spread times a signed draw. A set camera gate bit then thins the spawn by distance. GenerateTime, GenerateTimeArea and GenerateTimeVertex test the global density factor of the manager instead of the chance.

A spawn creates the child unit and sends one payload to the child control nodes of three listener groups. Group 0 receives position, direction, speed scalar, acceleration scalar and the drag flag, group 1 the euler angles of the spawner matrix plus the spawn step sum, group 2 the row lengths of the spawner matrix. The coordinate id at descriptor +0x58 of the first group 0 receiver selects the transform of the position and direction.

Area kinds 1 to 3 are a sphere, a box and a cylinder that turn three random axis values and further draws into a position and a direction, and kind 5 leaves both at zero. The axis values follow the bit pairs of the flag byte at area +0x1e.
Area kind 4 resolves a vertex of the model resource at node work +0x2c through 0x00d996b0. The vertex choice and the transform of the vertex are not read.

The Position3DGenerated, Angle3DGenerated and Scale3DGenerated modules keep the payload in their work buffer at message type 2 and add the elapsed ticks divided by 5000 in their calc. The position follows origin + direction * speed * t + direction * acceleration * t^2 / 2 and the drag flag selects a damped integration.
A child unit ends when its time reaches the end tick at unit entry +0x28. With bit 1 of the instance flags set the time wraps over the loop fields at +0x2c and +0x30 up to the count at +0x34.

ManyGenerateUnitTime turns the events of a Genesis slot into a particle count with a chance per event and ManyGenerateDrawLine spawns that many particles through the form, motion and line routines. The record offsets of the form, motion and line modules follow from the work buffer offsets the routines read and from the installed values.
The density factors of the manager that gate the GenerateTime handlers sit at manager +0x2c and +0x30. Their default and the code that sets them were not traced.

genesis.meaning: The value object stores the constant term at +0x00 and zero at +0x0c, the count already emitted.
Entering a degree 0 segment emits the integer part of its constant term minus the count emitted.
A nonzero dword at [[value +0x04] +0x10] stops the burst after it stores the constant term at +0x00. The meaning of that condition is UNKNOWN.

The elapse routine branches on the degree byte: 0 does nothing, 1 and 2 count events, any other value logs an exponent error.
A degree 1 segment with a rate above zero peaks at c0 + c1 * x.
A degree 1 segment with a rate of zero or below peaks at c0 + c1 * max(x - span, 0).
A degree 2 segment without a quadratic term peaks at c0 + c1 * x for a rising line and c0 + c1 * (x - span) for a falling one.
With a quadratic term the peak is the largest of the step start, the step end and the vertex at -c1 / c2 when it lies inside the step.
No event when the peak is below the emitted count, else the truncated difference.
With a quadratic term above zero the first trunc(N(x) - emitted) of the n events are queued with one shared age and the root solver ages the rest.
Solves c0 + c1 t + (c2 / 2) t^2 = target for the age of an event.
Adds the event to one of the two genesis buffers of the effect, the sure buffer or the ring buffer.
The event pass calls descriptor slot +0x9c of the owning control node with the node work buffer, its parameter block, a flag and the age in ticks.
